_comment: THE REOPENED SEARCHES, brief 14 under the rulings of 21 September (L9).
A DOMAIN IS NEVER DERIVED FROM A PROJECT'S NAME. Twenty hydrogen entries were
classed `searched, none found` where every host tried was either one of the four
boilerplate EU press URLs or a machine-generated <projectname>.com/.eu/.<cc>
triple. For those the search never happened, so the entries reopen as
`not_searched` and are searched here BY A RECORDED ROUTE.
THE ROUTE IS A SEARCH-ENGINE RESULT AND THE QUERY IS WRITTEN DOWN, which is one
of the three provenances the ruling allows — the other two being the list's own
owner field and a funder or permit document. Fourteen located an owner host.
Six did not, and that is recorded as a searched-and-not-located rather than as a
route: search engine, query recorded per entry
